Name: More Teas
Author: pray3rz
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]This mod ﻿reimagines ﻿the vanilla tea processing and adds new tea items.

[b]Features[/b]

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]2+ new Machines[/size]
[*][size=3]20+ new Artisan Goods[/size]
[*][size=3]10+  new Chinese teas(crops):[/size]
[*][spoiler]1. Dragon Well Tea
[size=3]2. Keemun Tea[font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font]3. Spring Snail Tea
4. Yellow Mountain Fur Peak Tea
5. Junshan Silver Needle Tea
6. Xinyang Maojian Tea
7. Luan Melon Seed Tea
8. Duyun Maojian Tea
9. Big Red Robe Tea
10. Iron Goddess of Mercy Tea[/spoiler]
[/size][/list][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]
Changes Vanilla Tea Processing

 ----------------   keg    ---------------
|  Tea Leaves  |  ---->  |  Green Tea  | 
 ----------------            ---------------

to More teas Processing

﻿[/size]----------------    Drying   -----------------------    Packaging    ----------------   Making   --------
|  Tea Leaves  |  ------->  |  Dried Tea Leaves  |  ----------->  |  Packed Tea  |  ------->  |  Tea  |
----------------                 -----------------------                       ----------------                --------

[b][size=2]Packaging Machine[/size][/b]
[size=1]Unlocked at Farming lvl 3[/size]

[b][size=2]Tea Pot [/size][/b]
[size=1]Unlocked at Farming lvl 4[/size]

[size=4][b]Config Options[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]﻿﻿Enhanced Vanilla Tea: Retextures, renames, and overrides both vanilla tea to the MoreTeas feature.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Vanilla Category Overrides: Enables turning vanilla tea item into the 'Tea' category. This effect is only visual. [/size][i][size=2]Only works if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿ installed.[/size][/i][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Category Overrides: Enables turning tea items into the 'Tea' category. This effect is only visual. [/size][i][size=2]Only works if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿ installed. [/size][/i][/font]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Install
[/size][/b][size=3]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS]Install ﻿[/font][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/font][/size]
[*][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS]Install ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url]﻿﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore﻿[/url]﻿.[/font][/size]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]﻿(Option) Download and the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Download the latest version of this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[CP] Pray3rz's More Teas' folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]You're done; run the game using SMAPI![/size][/font]
[/list]
